name: Tanger Outlets Deer Park
summary: Tanger Outlets Deer Park is Long Island's premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 100 brand-name and designer outlet stores. With an impressive 4.5-star rating and convenient location in Deer Park, NY, the center offers exceptional value on quality merchandise with extended hours during peak shopping seasons.
demographics: Tanger Outlets Deer Park attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers from Long Island and the greater New York metropolitan area, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income families seeking brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. The trade area draws heavily from Suffolk and Nassau counties, appealing to households with annual incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000 who prioritize quality brands at outlet pricing. The center sees significant weekend traffic from families and younger adults aged 25-54, with many visitors combining shopping trips with dining and entertainment activities in the surrounding Deer Park area.
description: Tanger Outlets Deer Park stands as Long Island's premier outlet shopping destination, offering an exceptional collection of brand-name and designer outlet stores at unbeatable prices. Located at 152 The Arches Circle in Deer Park, New York, this expansive outlet center features over 100 stores representing some of the most sought-after brands in fashion, home goods, accessories, and more. The center operates with convenient hours throughout the week, opening at 10:00 AM daily and closing at 8:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays, with slightly earlier closing times on other days. With special extended hours during peak shopping seasons like Black Friday (opening at 6:00 AM) and adjusted schedules for major holidays, Tanger Outlets Deer Park accommodates shoppers year-round. The center has earned an impressive 4.5-star rating from nearly 14,000 reviews, reflecting its popularity and the quality shopping experience it provides to visitors from across the New York metropolitan area and beyond.
